key.name: icon-name
key.description: Icon theme name or absolute path to a *-symbolic.svg. Empty means the bundled default.

key.name: show-label
key.description: Show a text label next to the top bar icon.

key.name: label-text
key.description: Text of the optional top bar label.

key.name: open-shortcut
key.description: Accelerator that opens PictoTxt. Empty disables the shortcut. Stored as an array because GNOME Shell keybindings require type "as".

key.name: auto-copy
key.description: Copy extracted text to the clipboard automatically.

key.name: monospace
key.description: Use a monospace font for the extracted text.
